revision_convention.note: One convention among many, stated here as data. No code may depend on it. Phase 4's structure inference must reach the same conclusion without reading this file.

expected_diff.why: In draft-2 the confrontation at the bridge is relayed through Neve rather than fought directly by Auber. Everything else is held constant, so a diff reporting changes elsewhere is reporting noise.
expected_diff.note: The attribution matters as much as the change. Both drafts must be analysed by the same run configuration, or the diff cannot distinguish a rewrite from a better prompt.

minor_character_control.why: One scene only. A pipeline that promotes her to a principal is over-weighting dialogue volume in a single passage.
